connector.name: Chartwire
connector.registryDescription: Generate production-ready chart code (Recharts, Chart.js, ECharts, Plotly) from a prompt.
connector.summary: Hosted at chartwire.helpfulbutton140.workers.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the outturndev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer u_<userId>_<token>. Get a free token at https://chartwire.helpfulbutton140.workers.dev (no credit card).
